com.esignal.jstandard.beans.flex

Interface FlexDataField

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.lang.Iterable<FlexDataField>
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    DbcFlexDataField

    public interface FlexDataField
extends java.lang.Iterable<FlexDataField>
    A Flexible Data Field which represents a single data field or a composite data field that is composed of one or more FlexDataFields. For instance a TickEvent may have a FlexDataField that represents a single value such as bid_price, or a BarEvent may have a composite FlexDataFieldvalue such as bid_price that is composed of other values such as open, high, low, close, volume.
    • Use getName() to get the name of the field.
    • Use getType() to get the FlexData.DATATYPE of the field.
      • If the type is FlexData.DATATYPE.COMPOSITE, isIterable() will return true and you will use Iterable.iterator() to get an Iterator<FlexDataField> on which you will iterate the fields that compose this Flexible Data Field. If a protocol error occurs while decoding the payload received in the response, the iterator.next() will throw an InvalidDataException. If this happens, the data received in the response is not reliable.
      • If the type is FlexData.DATATYPE.UNKNOWN, use getRawType() and getValueAsByteBuffer() or getValueAsByteArray() to get the raw bytes. Contact ICE Data Services for information on how to decode the raw type.
      • Else, use isNull() to check if the value is null, if not null, use the appropriate getValueAs*() method for the FlexData.DATATYPE returned from getType(). For instance if getType() returns FlexData.DATATYPE.INT64 use getValueAsInteger(). InvalidDataConversionException will be thrown if an inappropriate getValueAs*() method is called.
    Since:
    01-024-0000
    Author:
    ICE Data Services
